preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Contract must have accumulated token balance from fees (at least _minTokenBalance)

exploit_hint: As owner, set _percentageOfLiquidityForMarketing to >100 (e.g., 1000) via setPercentageOfLiquidityForMarketing(). Then trigger swapAndLiquify by having a user transfer tokens (if contract has accumulated fee tokens). This will cause all BNB from token swaps to be sent to marketing/investing wallets instead of adding liquidity, allowing owner to drain contract's BNB balance to controlled addresses.
